notes.title: Clonizer 1.1.0 Update – New Mission, Planet & More!
notes.content:
[h3]CLONPO returns with the deployment of Patch v1.1.0![/h3]

Greetings, Clonees!

We’ve been listening to your feedback from the far reaches of the galaxy, and it's time to deploy a fresh wave of content and improvements! Our first big update, 1.1.0 brings a new mission, a brand new planet, deeper challenge scaling, quality-of-life settings, and a whole bunch of bug fixes. Whether you're commanding Clonees on a tiny screen or strategizing in full zoom-out glory, there's something in here for you.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Mechanics & Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New mission: Diplomacy[/b]! – Unlocks after completing 24 missions.
[*] [b]New planet: Rumbelia[/b]! – Unlocks after completing 24 missions.
[*] [b]C.E.P. levels are now more challenging[/b]!
[list]
[*] FFO damage & enemy spawn rates now scale up to 30% (was 20%) across 20 levels.
[*] Galaxius Strictus (middle galaxy choice) now also reaches 30% FFO damage and enemy spawn rate scaling across 20 levels.
[*] Special aliens from C.E.P. level 4 have been temporarily disabled. They’ll return in future updates with stronger and more unique designs! For now, expect slightly tougher versions of regular aliens in their place.
[/list][/list][h3]Player Experience[/h3][list]
[*] [b]New options under Gameplay Settings[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fast mode!
[*] Disable edge-scrolling (camera movement when the mouse reaches screen edges).
[*] Increased maximum zoom-out.
[/list][*] Small tutorial adjustments for Steam Deck.
[*] Several tooltip enhancements for improved clarity.[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where playing multiple DUPE-Bursts on a Dupee in quick succession could freeze the game.
[*] You can now specialize your Clonees even when playing on a 20-deck limited galaxy with 20 cards.
[*] Picking up Lonlee’s “Fire Cannons!” card with a full hand (10 cards) no longer crashes the game.
[*] Going back on certain event options no longer renders buttons unclickable or causes the loading screen to get stuck.
[*] The Alien Genes goody now works correctly on non-alien enemies (including Faultees and Cosmocows).
[/list]

Thanks for playing Clonizer and for being part of this weird galaxy we’re building together. More exciting content is already brewing—stay tuned, and don’t forget to report any anomalies to HQ!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/5c8f6e0f3e45cd0254d85e94f32003c72f18a461.png[/img]

notes.title: Clonizer Beta Branch Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that a Beta Branch for Clonizer is now live! This branch lets adventurous players like you test upcoming features, content, and balance changes before they hit the main game.

[h2]What's in the Beta?
[/h2][list]
[*] New content (currently a whole new planet and a mission!)
[*] Player experience improvements (fast mode, additional options)
[*] Bug fixes that might cause new bugs
[*] Balance changes we’re still fine-tuning
[*] Occasional dev-induced chaos
[/list]
This is a perfect chance to help shape the future of Clonizer by giving feedback, reporting issues, and generally being involved in it all.

[h2]How to Opt Into the Beta:
[/h2][olist]
[*] Right-click on Clonizer in your Steam Library.
[*] Select Properties.
[*] Go to the Betas tab.
[*] Choose beta - Clonizer Beta testing branch from the dropdown.
[/olist]
(You can always switch back to the default branch at any time!)

[h2]A Few Warnings:
[/h2][list]
[*] Saves made in the beta may not be compatible with the main branch.
[*] You will encounter bugs. Some of them might even be sentient.
[*] Feedback is golden—let us know what breaks and what shines!
[/list]

Thanks for being part of this journey with us. Happy cloning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/5c8f6e0f3e45cd0254d85e94f32003c72f18a461.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Update Preview: Diplomacy, Dance, and Difficulty
notes.content:
Hello fellow Clonees!
We want to give you a sneak peek at what we’ve been working on, and hear your thoughts! Most of these updates are planned for release during the first week of June, but adventurous players can expect to see them early on the public beta branch (bugginess included, free of charge!).

[h1]New Planet: Rumbelia[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/fd95e63c29711e850f5035320e22d6fbe3469bd7.jpg[/img]
Rumbelia is home to the chunky and charming Tumblegrubs—beefy creatures who burrow through stone, leaving behind holes that whistle tunes when the wind blows through. These tunes drive Tumblegrubs into a dance frenzy.
[list]
[*] Tumblegrubs take double damage while dancing.
[*] Floating Plate tiles cause nearby Tumblegrubs to dance when pressed on.
[/list] We loved how interactive planetary tiles could be, and with Rumbelia, we really leaned into that idea. The coordination between tile interaction and combat adds a fun layer of strategy we’re excited for you to try.

[h1]New Mission: Diplomacy!
[/h1]
CLONPO, in its infinite PR wisdom, has launched it's next peacekeeping campaign to take over the universe. Leading the charge? Our very literal diplomatic shuttle, PeacekeePR.
[list]
[*] The mission goal: Play the PeacekeePR card a set number of times.
[*] A new PeacekeePR card is generated every turn, but can only be played when it’s exactly in the center of your hand. [i]Got to aim that capsule just right.[/i]
[*] DiploBots on the planet can generate new PeacekeePR cards or push cards in your hand left or right.
[/list]
This mission focuses on card manipulation as a core mechanic. Clonees still contribute by activating bots (because no mission is complete without some exploration), but success will depend on smart card sequencing and planning. It’s meant to feel like a completely different gameplay experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/beef742c564015cc4c92c65b8516c35243cba827.png[/img]
[i]Do we end up building diplomatic bridges with the aliens? We’ve got no shortage of Clonees lining up to pilot the PeacekeePR, that's for sure.[/i]

[h1]Player Experience Improvements
[/h1]We’re introducing several new quality-of-life settings based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Fast Mode
[*] Increased Max Zoom
[*] Option to disable camera movement when the mouse hits screen edges
[/list]
...and more tweaks to help you play your way!

[h1]Balance Changes
[/h1]We’ve heard some of you say the game feels a bit too easy—and we agree. Our anonymous data shows a win rate above 50% at C.E.P. Level 1 and beyond, so we’re making adjustments.

That said, we don’t want to raise the base difficulty, as many players still struggle early on. So, we’re increasing the challenge scaling from C.E.P. levels.

We will initially do some boring number changes to get the tuning right.
But the next step could be cooler, more dynamic changes—maybe involving new aliens? 👀

We’d love to hear what you think about these. Your feedback helps us shape the future of Clonizer—and CLONPO appreciates your unpaid labor immensely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/5c8f6e0f3e45cd0254d85e94f32003c72f18a461.png[/img]

[b]BONUS:[/b] As a token of appreciation for scrolling this far, here's a rare footage of a Tumblegrub having too much fun after getting rigged. 

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOXYxbzlnanNyajF5NW15dGJoNnRmY2JtM3E1aHc5bmZ6dXVidGRyNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/DvTGlrCEeQI5t4VGPL/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Clonizer 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3]CLONPO returns with the deployment of Patch v1.0.4![/h3]

Hello, fellow Clonees!
This update brings a healthy batch of balance adjustments, bug fixes, [strike]new bug introducements[/strike], and player experience improvements, all guided by your feedback and the anonymous gameplay data we've received.

Here are some of the key insights that shaped this patch:

[b]First-run win rate is 10%.[/b]
Ideally, we’d want this to be 0% (failure builds character!), but we know this is a turn-based game, and some players are going to be just very skilled. Overall, we’re satisfied with this number.

[b]Win rate on the old “Normal” difficulty is 23%.[/b]
Not bad! But some players, especially those newer to roguelikes, expected a smoother ride. After all, it did say "Normal."
We believe that the problem wasn’t the difficulty itself, but how it was presented. So we moved the old normal to be the new hard, and added a new normal difficulty in-between.

[b]C.E.P. level 1+ win rates were over 50%.[/b]
Very surprising! Once players got the hang of things, they seem to be beating it with ease. We’ll be tightening this up in future updates.
Meanwhile, shoutout to the first player to conquer C.E.P. level 20 with R&D, after just 28 runs!
But Logistics Level 20? Still untouched…

[b]Most losses happened on the final boss mission.[/b]
This is expected to an extent, but we wanted the earlier planets to add more pressure—and also offer meaningful repair opportunities—to make that final showdown feel earned.

[h2]Patch Notes v1.0.4[/h2]
[h3]Mechanics & Balance[/h3][list]
[*] [b]New Difficulty Level[/b]:[list]
We’ve added a third difficulty setting! (for C.E.P. 0)
The old "Normal" becomes Hard.
A new Normal has been added between Easy and Hard.[/list]
[*] [b]Increased Early Pressure and Repair Opportunities[/b]:[list]
Increased alien spawn rate on levels 1–4.
The Hull node is now called the Repair Station, and is operated by our enthusiastic mechanic Craftee. It still grants +5 max hull, but now also offers 25% hull repair in exchange for -10 max hull. This node now appears slightly more frequently.
Repair bonus after the 4th planet reduced: 50% → 30%.[/list]
[*] [b]Less Repetition[/b]:[list]
Reduced the chances of encountering identical planets or missions back-to-back. When we release new planets or missions (which are already in the works!), they’ll be guaranteed not to appear consecutively.[/list]
[*] [b]Planet Balancing[/b]:[list]
Reduced alien spawn rate on Planet Sproutera (desert).
Increased alien spawn rates on Planet Darkus and Shroomides.[/list]
[*] [b]Boss Balancing[/b]:[list]
Milkee: Health reduced 30 → 25; milk thresholds now 15/5 (was 20/10).
Lonlee’s Clock Bomb: Teleportal mission damage: 5 → 4. Boss mission damage: 5 → 7
Increased spawn rate of Faultilizers on Stinkee’s teleportal mission.[/list]
[*] [b]Mission Balancing[/b]:[list]
Dupe Collect mission requirements slightly increased on some levels.
Extermination mission wave size slightly increased.
Reinforcement mission: Slightly fewer Faultees on some levels.
Mining mission: First level requirement slightly increased.[/list]
[*] Starting deck unlocks are now harder to earn.
[*] Regenerative Alloy (goody) now triggers on Rich Asteroids (instead of Repair Station). Hull repair effect: 4 → 5.
[/list][h3]Player Experience[/h3][list]
[*] FFO Alarm Added: You’ll now see a visual warning when FFO damage is about to spike. (No mechanical changes—just clarity.)
[*] Dupe Collect mission's pressurized tiles on the alarmed version now stand out more clearly.
[/list][h3]Community Items[/h3][list]
[*] Steam Community Items are now available! Check out our new profile backgrounds and emoticons, play to collect your favorite alien trading cards and wear our brand new CLONPO badges!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/9f16a2c1142e21ccc28c2d2ca67bce19146dbdf0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/981b64d0471c00dadb89c51a14d01b538b35af15.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/fb7e5f6858d31e43d104c2017559b5fec76fa3dc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/e6a1affd1f4d3812b5c99d5ab7214c264fd23c0c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/7763d1482f36916dacc0669a73ee5b160bbab799.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/d398e8740b96efff3346bde6824715e14c94c3ba.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/2156c0f25831e255fec457847dbdb6cffc2ec80b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/e5b6f14c91e144ebe46c577cdb3b4a7d0c883ec7.png[/img][/url]
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed camera getting stuck at the start of a level randomly.
[*] Fixed game getting stuck during timed turns if the timer runs out while targeting a card.
[*] Fixed Steam Cloud saves not working on Mac.
[*] Fixed game getting stuck when a card gets consumed while inspecting it in a pile.
[*] Added a potential fix for the loading screen freeze after events.
[*] Added a potential fix for rare random crashes.
[*] Fixed Wormhole event's skip choice preventing card rewards from appearing in future levels.
[*] Fixed several localization issues.
[*] Fixed "Best Turn" achievement stat not registering properly.
[*] Squashed a handful of minor visual bugs.[/list]

And lastly, here are some of the biggest things we have in works for you!

[h2]Future Changes[/h2][list]
[*] New mission!
[*] New planet!
[*] Higher C.E.P. balance (we suspect it might be too easy for experienced players)
[*] Additional settings:
- Fast animations option
- Increased zoom
- Toggle to turn off panning with mouse
[*] Controller support
[*] And much more![/list]

Please let us know what you think of the changes and what would you like to see more in the comments below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/5c8f6e0f3e45cd0254d85e94f32003c72f18a461.png[/img]

notes.title: Clonizer 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[h3]CLONPO has authorized the deployment of Patch v1.0.3! [/h3]

This update features key balance tweaks, bug fixes, and a handful of player experience improvements. Plus, we have some good news for Miracle Legumes believers and confetti enjoyers!

After reviewing player data, we noticed that while some players were consistently winning—even on their very first runs—the overall win rates were lower than intended. So, we’ve gently dialed down the difficulty in a few areas.
That said, we approached these changes with great caution. Clonizer is a roguelike with no meta-progression, which means challenge is central to its design. Make things too easy, and we risk undermining what makes it fun: player skill. Rest assured, experienced players can still achieve near-perfect win rates (even with cursed RNG) on C.E.P. levels 10 and below.

If these balance changes end up missing the mark—whether things still feel too brutal or suddenly too breezy—we’ll be listening to your feedback and remain fully open to further adjustments in future updates.

[h2]Patch Notes v1.0.3[/h2]
[h3]Mechanics & Balance[/h3][list]
[*] Slightly decreased FFO damage across all levels.
[*] Increased the turn FFO damage starts ramping up the boss level.
[*] In the Milkee boss fight, FFOs now try to abduct Cosmocows that are much closer to Clonizer.
[*] In Galaxius Easius, FFO damage now caps at a point (it no longer scales infinitely).
[*] Reduced the number of aliens waiting on planets when you land. This number gets affected by C.E.P. modifiers now, which means it should even out at higher C.E.P. levels.
[*] Miracle Legumes are now slightly less useless. Still pretty useless. But hey, miracles don’t grow on trees.
[/list][h3]Player Experience[/h3][list]
[*] Players must now sign a Difficulty Agreement™ before starting normal difficulty for the first time. This contract submits their soul to CLONPO and waives their right to protest. Even on bathroom walls!
[*] Added new effects for unlocking a new Clonizer or game mode, achieving a better score, and patch updates.
[*] Clickable units now blink to demand your attention.
[*] Added a new tutorial pop-up for the mining mission.
[*] Stink Seeds are now larger. Not smellier—just more visible.
[*] The deck screen can now be scrolled using WASD or arrow keys.
[*] There is now a minimum shrink limit for units. (Yes, we saw you trying to kill bosses with multiple Shrink Rays.)
[*] Capped how much camera zoom affects sound effect volume.
[*] Added confetti effects in various CLONPO-approved places. 🎉
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed global scores not showing up for daily galaxy.
[*] Fixed Portable Replicator not being able to be played on upgraded units.
[*] Leaving a card at Craftee no longer removes its permanent effects (e.g. bonus health from events).
[*] Logistics’ The Unseen starting deck now correctly tracks progress.
[*] Fixed a few additional visual bugs.
[*] Fixed a few localization issues.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/5c8f6e0f3e45cd0254d85e94f32003c72f18a461.png[/img]

notes.title: Clonizer Day 1 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who reached out with bug reports and feedback! We're working hard to make your gameplay experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible.

This first-day patch focuses primarily on fixing game-breaking bugs and addressing major outliers in difficulty. We're keeping a close eye on balance and will be making more fine-tuned adjustments in future updates. We will be making more informed decisions as we collect more gameplay data.

Please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts, feedback, or any issues you encounter — we’re listening!

[h2]Patch Notes v1.0.2[/h2]
[h3]Mechanics & Balance[/h3][list]
[*] Made Galaxius Easius much easier.
[*] Slightly decreased the spawn rate of Faultees on the reinforcement mission.
[*] Slightly decreased the spawn rate of Planet Sproutera (desert) aliens.
[*] Slightly increased the spawn rate of Planet Darkus (dark) aliens.
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed cards getting stuck in the middle of the screen if you kill a mutation quickly after you spawn it.
[*] Fixed game getting stuck on the Lonlee boss if bombs explode and kill units out of vision.
[*] Fixed game getting stuck at the end of the tutorial level if you loaded a save to the tutorial level. (If you have a save file remaining from the last version, you'll need to abandon the run.)
[*] Fixed action granted by card upgrades not working (for example Mutagen+).
[*] 21:9 and 16:10 resolution options should now show up in the settings correctly.
[*] Fixed a few tooltip errors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/5c8f6e0f3e45cd0254d85e94f32003c72f18a461.png[/img]

notes.title: Clonizer is out Now with a 20% Discount!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, fellow Clonees![/b]

What began as a humble school project back in 2019 has grown into something far beyond what we ever imagined. After years of hard work, countless late nights, and more [strike]coffee[/strike] tea than we’d like to admit, we’re beyond excited to finally [b]release Clonizer today[/b]!

Over the years, Clonizer has gone through many changes, because we have. What started as a student project slowly evolved, as we leveled up our skills, redrawn our visuals, rewrote our code (again and again), and found our voice as creators. It’s been a long road, but we’re proud to say: it’s ready.

Though our core team is just [b]two people[/b], we’ve never been alone in this journey. We’re incredibly grateful to the talented folks who helped us along the way — with VFX, sound design, music, publishing, and more — and to you, our community, for your encouragement, feedback, and bug reports, as we built this adventure full of color, silly humor, and happily exploited Clonees.
To everyone who’s been waiting patiently all these years — thank you for your trust and your support. You kept us going.

We can’t wait for you to explore what we’ve built. We definitely poured all our hearts into it, and we hope it makes you smile.

[h3]Check out our free post-release poster:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268682/cfa1ead7b2713cc65707d5c18f851d088ea61f71.png[/img]

[h3]A Word from our Publisher: Rogue Duck Interactive![/h3]

Clonizer is definitely one of our most polished releases by far. We are glad to be publishing a title like this, alongside our previous deckbuilder releases Dice & Fold and Pairs & Perils; Clonizer became one of the most fun and deep strategies in our library.

After you enjoy Clonizer, give [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655590/Kingdoms_Deck/]Kingdom's Deck's free demo[/url] a try, which will come out in 2 weeks!

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.5.6
notes.content:
Hey Clonees! As we draw closer to our Early Access release, we're focusing more on the mechanics and balancing aspects of the game. Here are the changes reflected in the demo version:

[h2]Demo Patch Notes v0.5.6[/h2]
[h3]Mechanics & Balance[/h3][list]
[*] Musprouts now use an action to unburrow. Their health is reduced by 1. Their spawn rate is increased accordingly.
[*] FFOs now attack for a bit less damage on their first two attacks.
[*] Enemies spawn a bit further away from Clonizer on level starts. Enemy starting spawn powers are reduced slightly.
[*] On the Reinforcement mission, Faultee raids start weaker and grow stronger over time.
[*] Backup Shields is now common. AdaptoShield is rare. Reduced AdaptoShield’s shield rate.
[*] Decreased DUPE-Buffer’s shield by 1.
[*] MutaTank is buffed.
[*] Changed Craftee’s Hull Spray goody.
[/list][h3]Player Experience[/h3][list]
[*] Improved sound effects.
[*] Tip shown before a level starts is now visible for longer.
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to get stuck on the loading screen when an Extermination mission takes place in Desert Planet.
[*] Fixed some props not appearing correctly on Reinforcement mission.
[*] Craftee Hull Spray no longer adds another +30 hull whenever the game is loaded from a save.
[*] Abandoning when on the galaxy map works properly again.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.5.5
notes.content:
As we joined the #TurnBasedThursdayFest, we wanted to address one of the most common feedback we received during our demo period, which was how each mission felt very similar to each other: They eventually all boiled down to moving Clonees to certain places on the map. This changes now! We reworked all three missions to each have their unique identity, playstyle, and feeling. And we aim to add new missions to the game as we move forward.

We highly recommend to you to check them out!

[i]Below are the combined notes from both versions v0.5.4 and v0.5.5. We've released them only a few days apart.[/i]

[h2]Patch Notes v0.5.5[/h2]

[h3]Mechanics & Balance[/h3][list]
[*] Replaced Shield Generators mission with a new Reinforcements mission.
[*] Reworked DUPE Collect mission completely.
[*] Reworked Training Camp mission into Extermination.
[*] Rebalanced and reworked many cards.
[*] Added 15+ goodies to the demo. Changed CLONPO-Air goody.
[*] Clonee Monument now has a range of 1.
[/list][h3]Player Experience[/h3][list]
[*] Mutation cards no longer glow if there isn’t a mutatable unit on the planet. Damage cards do not stop the end turn button from filling if there isn’t a valid visible enemy.
[*] Swapped the position of abandon and return buttons on the pause menu.
[*] During the ranged attack targeting, color of FFOs and unit health bars are now dimmed correctly.
[*] When multiple units get in line to fight, dying units will now fall behind fighting units.
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Playing Chili Pepper on MutaCube no longer breaks the game.
[*] Moving the camera no longer causes the cards to hover/unhover incorrectly.
[*] Pressing the confirm button multiple times on the goody swap interface no longer causes issues.
[*] If the first Faultee encountered is Super Faultee at the Teleportal mission, it no longer triggers Cloneestructor dialogue, causing a weird visual bug.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.5.3
notes.content:
While there are many ongoing developments for the full version in the background, we've updated the demo as well to reflect the changes. In this rather significant update, we aimed to address an issue that many of you voiced concerns about: there was something wrong with FFOs! The most significant pain point seemed to be that FFOs were attacking for a large portion of your maximum hull, creating a feeling of having nothing to do but defend. When the cards didn't come your way, losing half of your hull in a single attack was undoubtedly frustrating.

To address this issue, we've reduced both the damage of attacks and the shield values of cards. We believe that this adjustment should alleviate the frustration of constantly feeling the need to defend while maintaining the challenge and not making the game overly easy.

Please let us know what you think about it!

[h2]Patch Notes v0.5.3[/h2]

[h3]Mechanics & Balance
[/h3][list]
[*] Decreased the shield value of many cards.
[*] Decreased the FFO damage. It also now starts ramping up much later.
[*] One Construction Guide is now guaranteed to spawn adjacent to Clonizer.
[*] Clonee upgrades now grant “Quickfeet - first movement doesn’t cost action”, instead of +1 health.
[*] Alien spawn rate is decreased.
[*] FFO attack hits after aliens move.
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to drag units (happened randomly, hotfixed last patch).
[*] If you have both Broken Clock & Construction Helmet and Clonee spawns on the Clonizer’s tile, it no longer gains extra HP.
[*] UI elements no longer are clickable when the loading screen is moving, potentially leading to unintended situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if enemy units try to move into tiles that are full.
[*] Plasmarifle Program’s continuation event no longer can be encountered normally.
[*] If an FFO fails to spawn because its tile is full, it no longer stays at the tile forever.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Release - with improvements! v0.5.2
notes.content:
Hey Clonees, Clonizer Demo is out! This time with tweaked shield & FFO mechanics, more content, and many improvements!

Here are some highlights from the patch notes:

[list]
[*] FFOs now always attack every other turn.
[*] Shields only reset after an FFO attack ends.
[*] New cards and blueprints are added to the demo pool.
[*] Faster end turn animations and camera movements.
[*] Big revamp of music and sound effects.
[*] Lots of balance tweaks & quality of life improvements
[/list]

For the full list of changes, you can check out the patch notes section from in-game!

Don't hesitate to check our demo out! And please let us know what you think about it. You can use our 
[url=https://discord.gg/aHRf9qBxca]Discord Channel[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2449450/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] to reach us.

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.4.2
notes.content:
Hey Clonees! 🌙 Land of the Crescent - Games From Turkey 🌙 event has just ended!

We are thrilled by how many of you played the demo! Considerable amount of you played it for more than three hours! For such limited content, CLONPO management was not expecting this at all. Thank you so much!

As this was our first time releasing our demo, we received a lot of feedback. We have already started working on them and you can see some of it on the patch notes below. Expect to hear fresh ideas and more squashed bugs soon!

Also, our demo is going to be available a little while longer, so feel free to embark on another expedition while you can!

[h2]Patch Notes v0.4.2 - 20 August 2023 - Including hotfixes during v.0.4.1
[/h2]

[h3]Mechanics & Balance
[/h3][list]
[*]Slightly decreased the distance Teleportals spawn from the spaceship (at the final mission of the demo).
[/list][h3]User Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now there is an option inside gameplay settings to lock the cursor to the game window.
[*] Each music now has its own victory and defeat jingles.
[*] Small improvements on the audio systems.
[/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Potentially fixed the issue that rarely caused the game to get stuck on Sproutera’s heatwave turns. Please report if it still happens.
[*] Potentially fixed the issue that causes the game to crash when the planet explanation videos are shown. Please report if it still happens.
[*] If an alien spawns on top of a Clonee with a Plasmagun, the game no longer gets stuck on the tutorial dialogue about how to use a Plasmagun.
[*] Super Faultees no longer fail to fire their Plasmagun at the end of the turn they spawned.
[*] Raw DUPE no longer can be invisible on its first turn.
[*] Mutating a Clonee with HP providing bonuses such as Space Saber no longer causes it to lose the HP gained by it. Instead, HP gained by these bonuses will be restored fully.
[*] Turkish font and localization fixes.
[/list]
